title: DealerFee
description: One mandatory dealer charge or required add-on, in whole units of the enclosing Vehicle.currency or rooftop.currency (USD when omitted). Include dealer-paid taxes or fees passed to the buyer; exclude only government-required consumer charges and optional products. The amount is already included when Vehicle.price is present. Without price it is informational and cannot establish a payable amount. Names must be specific, nonempty and unique within one fees array.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the mandatory charge or dealer-required add-on.

amount.description: Amount in whole units of the enclosing vehicle's or rooftop's currency (USD when omitted). When Vehicle.price is present, this amount is already included and MUST NOT be added again. Without Vehicle.price, the amount is informational only.
